memoryRule: a sustained pressure load sinks one local contour, bends a remote contour, and changes the seam field inherited by later loads
interactionRule: pointerdown arms without writing; release after 560ms commits; light presses refuse; Enter/Space share deterministic load; Delete lifts latest; R/Escape releases
representationRupture: layered DOM/CSS plates, semantic mark strip, and raster patch picture -> one continuous inline SVG pressure slab with a closed contour and fibrous seams
encounterRupture: return loop, look-then-leave, and cross-seam drag -> stillness and sustained weight as the causal threshold
temporalRupture: registration debt, moved absence, and false relation -> material load that changes how the next silhouette is produced
mediumRupture: DOM/CSS, semantic HTML, and Canvas 2D -> inline SVG path geometry driven by a deterministic state engine
changedRule: Pressure is stored as material memory rather than drawn as a mark; a held load is routed to a wrong edge.
visibleConsequence: The touched region sinks, a remote region bends, and five seam paths inherit measurable changes; later loads build from the altered slab.
falsifier: Delete if the blind work reads as a generic blob, if a shallow press commits, if only witness UI changes, if remote contour change is not visible, or if lifting is inexact.
deletionCondition: Delete v030 if the changed material rule cannot be found in the closed contour and seam geometry without captions or controls.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
